Thus the ratio of the two factors strictly increases in inverse temperature. Its high- and low-temperature limits are omega_-/omega_+<1 and infinity, proving exactly one crossing. The standard-library independent rate solver passed 175 parameter checks and one root example. No numerical test is used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The published global current identities and detuning-induced rectification are prior results and explicitly credited. The new statement is an exact, unique inversion in the common absolute temperature scale at every fixed hot/cold temperature ratio, proved by a global monotonicity comparison between competing frequencies. Upadhyay et al. describe detuning as fixing the sign despite displaying opposing terms; Fogedby derives transport but not the universal crossing, and Khandelwal et al. optimize device performance in different regimes. Novelty remains conditional on no unidentified equivalent treatment.
residual_risks: An equivalent one-crossing monotonicity argument in an unindexed or uninspected later study may exist.
The scalar theorem relies on equality and spectral flatness of bath rates; physically structured spectra need not exhibit this behavior.
Full text for the 2009 spin-chain comparator was not inspected, so it is not classified as definitively non-covering from an abstract alone.
